page.content:
Co-creator and head writer of the Night Vale episodes.

How Jeffrey Cranor connects

  • Topic: Welcome to Night Vale — Jeffrey Cranor co-created Welcome to Night Vale.
  • Work: Welcome to Night Vale (show) — Cranor co-writes the Welcome to Night Vale episodes.
  • Faction: Night Vale Presents — Cranor co-founded Night Vale Presents around the mothership show.

What is Jeffrey Cranor?

Jeffrey Cranor co-created Welcome to Night Vale, writes the bulk of the episode scripts with Fink, and helps run Night Vale Presents beside the mothership show.

Key threads lead to Welcome to Night Vale, Welcome to Night Vale (show) and Night Vale Presents.
